name: Deep Slumber (Hellenic)
body:
School enchantment (compulsion) [mind-affecting]; Level Hellenic sorceress 3

CASTING

Casting Time 1 round
Components V, S, M (ointment made of a rare herbal mixture worth 50 gp)

EFFECT

Range touch
Effect one or more living creatures touched
Duration 1 min./level
Saving Throw Will negates; Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

For one round each creature you successfully make a melee touch attack against is affected by a magical slumber up to a total of 10 HD of creatures affected. HD that are not sufficient to affect a creature are wasted. Sleeping creatures are helpless. Slapping or wounding awakens an affected creature, but normal noise does not. Awakening a creature is a standard action (an application of the aid another action). Hellenic deep slumber does not target unconscious creatures, constructs, or undead creatures.
